experiments_list._corpus: Resolved 2026-09-03: the published runs used v4_dolma-v1_7_llama. All three sbatch scripts in tasks/archive/math_n_index call evaluation_creative_index_parr, label the task '<model>-<domain>-dolma', and the README documents the same command. The other script (v4_rpj_llama_s4) appears to be dead.
experiments_list._throughput: Measured 2026-09-03: 8 workers drove the public endpoint to refuse 10/10 probes. Single-threaded sustains ~5-8 req/s. One document at one n-gram size is ~400 requests, so the full paper run (100 docs x 3 domains x 8 sizes) is ~1M requests and is not feasible against the public endpoint.
experiments_list._lm_tokenizer: Production passed --lm_tokenizer, so the Llama tokenizer is what scored the published numbers. The gated meta-llama repo is replaced by an ungated mirror whose token ids were checked against infini-gram's own.
